newsitem.title: POLAND: NFI SEEN AT PLN 146.7 AT YEAR-END - POLL.
newsitem.headline: NFI SEEN AT PLN 146.7 AT YEAR-END - POLL.

text.p: Polish brokerages see mass privatisation units rising to 146.7 zlotys in the end of December, 11.5 percent lower than forecasted a month ago, a poll by Nowa Europa daily showed.
It said brokerages expected the units to rise to 216.3 zlotys by mid-1997, 4.2 percent higher than forecasted a month ago.
NFI units were trading at 139 zlotys on Wednesday.
